verdict.rationale: Sift documents Workflows as its own rules automation platform. Workflows make risk-based decisions in real time during key events, and custom Decisions (e.g. Ban Account, Cancel Order) tie those decisions to backend business actions. The evidence describes the capability only at overview level, and a dated founder comment about the ML approach is not concrete counter-evidence against the current Workflows feature. Missing for 10: documented rule/condition definition details, documentation of how triggered actions execute automatically end-to-end, independent or hands-on corroboration of Workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Sift offers Workflows, a powerful rules automation platform, and Review Queues.
Workflows enable you to make risk-based decisions in real time during key events.
Learn to set up custom Decisions, like Ban Account or Cancel Order, that are connected to real business actions in your backend.
